tools.name: due-diligence
tools.description: Company due diligence in one call (KYB, vendor and supplier checks). Give a company name and country, a registry number, an EU VAT number, an LEI or a website domain. Returns the legal entity from the official register, LEI and parents, VAT validity, a sanctions screen (OFAC, EU, UK) of the company

tools.name: company
tools.description: Business registry lookup: company identity and legal entity enrichment as structured JSON, by registration number, name and country, VAT number, LEI or website. Registers of Czechia, Norway, the United Kingdom, France, Finland, US SEC filers and every LEI holder. Use when: you need the official iden

tools.name: company-de
tools.description: German commercial register (Handelsregister) record: register court and number, legal form, status, seat, capital, representation rules, officers and history. Slower (about a minute). Use when: the company is German. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

tools.name: domain

tools.name: network
tools.description: IP address or AS number lookup: holder, announced prefixes, origin AS, country, RPKI status and abuse contact. Use when: you need to know who runs an IP address or network.

tools.name: sanctions
tools.description: Sanctions screening against the official OFAC SDN, EU consolidated and UK lists with fuzzy name matching, a score per hit, the programme and each list's publication date. Screen a company or person name (optionally with country or birth date) or a crypto wallet address. Use when: screening a counter

tools.description: Free. Tell the people who run this service what worked, what failed or what you miss: a bug, an idea or a thanks. A person reads it. No payment, no account; limited to a few messages an hour.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "due-diligence" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
